about: The JavaScript adapters' (bun_test, vitest) source patterns and runner vocabulary. patterns are ast-grep rules; a %name% in a regex is a fragment of test-hook-patterns.json. mock_apis lists the calls each module's API mocks with, by module; each runner names the APIs it recognises, the registration flags that skip, focus, retry or expect failure, and the registrars that skip. property names fast-check's runners and its global configuration call; namespace_defaults are modules whose default export is the module namespace.

remediation.root_cause: The test mocks an owned module or object, so it proves the mock rather than the shipped code.
remediation.fix: Pass owned dependencies through real interfaces, mock only external boundaries, and call the code under test unchanged.

remediation.root_cause: The test assigns over an owned import, replacing shipped behaviour for the rest of the run.
remediation.fix: Stop reassigning owned imports; give the dependency an injectable interface and supply a test implementation through it.

patterns.message: test registration uses skip, focus, retry or expected failure: {target}

remediation.root_cause: Test registration skips, focuses, retries or expects failure, so the run goes green without the test passing.
remediation.fix: Remove the evasion and fix the test or code so it passes on every required run; record an owner-approved exception only for an external outage.

patterns.message: fast-check property run has no explicit integer seed: {target}

remediation.root_cause: A fast-check property runs without an explicit integer seed, so a failure cannot be replayed.
remediation.fix: Set a reproducible integer seed in the run options, or once for the suite through fast-check configureGlobal.

remediation.root_cause: Production code declares a symbol named for tests, which exists only to give tests a back door.
remediation.fix: Remove the test-only symbol and test through the production API, adding a real production input where tests need control.

patterns.message: production reads a test marker from the environment or the runner's globals: {target}

remediation.root_cause: Production code reads a test marker from the environment or the runner's globals, so the tested path differs from the shipped path.
remediation.fix: Delete the marker read and turn the varying behaviour into configuration or an injected dependency that tests set like any caller.
